rules: Each campaign writes its own final protocol and source hashes before any arm runs. Controls inherit primary values except the explicit variable changes.
Finish the source qualification and failed-provider clock corrections before final campaigns. Preserve the earlier small pilot as diagnostic, not final-candidate evidence.
Do not edit candidate, engine or evaluator during a comparison. Any required correction creates a new version and retains old results.
Include failures, costs, right-censored outcomes and every declared seed. No selection by favorable model answer or delivery.
Compare physical service, native deficits, sufficient and first-useful response times, coverage, overprovisioning, distance and fuel.
Human reading capacity and formal delay are modeled assumptions; sensitivity profiles and B8 can refute or limit the claim. Do not equate laboratory minutes with real lives saved.
This is an internally authored synthetic workload, not independent disaster calibration or a secret holdout. Gemini and GCP remain later phases.
